import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_12/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_12/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join on Athlete column (inner join to keep only matching athletes)
df = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="Athlete", how="inner")

# Ensure columns have correct types as per target schema:
# Target Schema: ['Athlete': string, 'Age': float, 'Year': integer, 'Closing Ceremony Date': string,
# 'Gold Medals': integer, 'Silver Medals': integer, 'Bronze Medals': integer, 'Total Medals': integer, 'Country': string]

# Convert Age to float
df["Age"] = df["Age"].astype(float)

# Convert Year to int
df["Year"] = df["Year"].astype(int)

# Closing Ceremony Date as string (already string, but ensure no datetime type)
df["Closing Ceremony Date"] = df["Closing Ceremony Date"].astype(str)

# Convert medal counts and Total Medals to int
medal_cols = ["Gold Medals", "Silver Medals", "Bronze Medals", "Total Medals"]
for col in medal_cols:
    df[col] = df[col].astype(int)

# Country as string
df["Country"] = df["Country"].astype(str)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    "Athlete",
    "Age",
    "Year",
    "Closing Ceremony Date",
    "Gold Medals",
    "Silver Medals",
    "Bronze Medals",
    "Total Medals",
    "Country",
]

df = df[target_columns]

# Write the final dataframe to the target path without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/target_multisource.csv"
df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
